title: Stock counts
description: Count a warehouse and correct its stock.

help.title: About stock counts
help.overview: Record what is really on the shelf in one warehouse, then correct your stock to match. A count stays a draft while you count; nothing changes until you apply it.

sections.title: Each count
items: Add the products with the quantity you counted. Leave the count empty for an item you didn't count; it's left alone.
Apply count sets On hand to the counted quantity for each counted item, and records each difference in Stock movements.
Counting less than is reserved for orders is accepted: Available then shows the shortfall.
Only a draft can be edited, applied or cancelled. An applied count can't be undone or deleted; count again instead.
